children: Nomadar signed an Equity Purchase Agreement to acquire the Fox Soccer Academy businesses in New York, North Carolina, the United Kingdom and Austria. The deal includes $2.0 million cash at closing, $500,000 in Nomadar shares at $3.36575 per share, two deferred payments totaling $2.6 million (cash and stock), and a contingent earnout of up to $1.5 million. Sellers will receive 4,419,607 Class B units, representing 49% of Fox Soccer Holding, and a $600,000 holdback applies for two years. Nomadar also secured an option to purchase the sellers’ remaining interests for $4.4 million within a set period, and the parties adopted an LLC Agreement establishing a three-manager board and unit classes.
